meta_title: Daddy Hunger | The 10 Commandments of Fatherhood
meta_description: Daddy Hunger helps fathers heal, grow, reconnect, and create a healthier legacy for their children. The 10 Commandments of Fatherhood by Ray Upchurch is coming Fall 2026.
hero_eyebrow: From Daddy Hunger to a New Legacy of Fatherhood
hero_lead: A memoir-driven guide to becoming the kind of father whose children feel safe, seen, heard, loved, and prepared.
featured_quote: “The greatest gift you will ever give your child is the father you are still becoming.”
mission_heading: Helping fathers heal, grow, reconnect, and create a healthier legacy.
mission_paragraphs: Daddy Hunger began with a simple but painful truth: many children grow up longing for the presence, protection, affirmation, and love of a father.
Today, Daddy Hunger is a mission to help fathers become more present, emotionally healthy, trustworthy, and prepared so that every child can feel safe, seen, heard, loved, and prepared.
promises_heading: What every child should experience through a father.

promises.title: Safe
promises.description: A child can tell the truth, ask for help, admit a mistake, or share fear without humiliation or abandonment.

promises.title: Seen
promises.description: A child knows their father notices who they are, not only what they accomplish.

promises.title: Heard
promises.description: A child feels that their thoughts, emotions, questions, and experiences matter.

promises.title: Loved
promises.description: A child knows love is not something they must earn through performance, agreement, or perfection.

promises.title: Prepared
promises.description: A child receives the wisdom, values, confidence, and practical guidance needed to face life.

guide_heading: Begin with five promises you can practice today.
guide_description: Get the practical Daddy Hunger guide for helping children feel safe, seen, heard, loved, and prepared. It includes a clear promise, a short explanation, and one action step for each area.
guide_preview_title: 5 Promises Every Child Needs From Their Father
guide_preview_description: A practical guide to helping children feel safe, seen, heard, loved, and prepared.
book_feature_heading: Ten principles for healing, responsibility, connection, and legacy.
book_feature_paragraphs: The 10 Commandments of Fatherhood draws from Ray’s childhood, his experience raising two sons, the lessons of divorce and rebuilding, and the stories encountered through Daddy Hunger.
This is not a book about perfect fathers. It is a book about fathers willing to tell the truth, repair what they can, and keep becoming.
ray_heading: A father, grandfather, speaker, filmmaker, and creator of Daddy Hunger.
ray_description: Ray’s journey into fatherhood began with questions about becoming a good father without having known his own. Through raising his sons, rebuilding after hardship, and years of listening to families across the country, he learned that presence, emotional safety, truth, and love are essential.
vision_heading: Heal the Father. Reach the Child. Transform the Legacy.
vision_description: Daddy Hunger is growing into a platform for books, practical resources, speaking engagements, workshops, family experiences, media projects, partnerships, and transformational events.
closing_heading: No father can change the past. Every father can decide what happens next.
